description:
Five generated regions, three mechanisms (docs/agents/generated-docs.md): `docs/compile-errors.md`, the two lists in `docs/scope.md`, `usage-rules.md` and `usage-rules/language.md` are regenerated with `mix run -e` and pasted by hand, each guarded by its own doc test (compile_errors_doc_test, scope_doc_test, usage_rules_test); `priv/defk_messages.h` and the scoreboard tables each have a task with `--check`. The marker machinery (`Defk.Examples.Tables.put/3`, `get/2`) exists and serves only the tables.

Settled shape (grilling 2026-10-19):
- One task `mix defk.docs [--check]` owns every region. `mix defk.messages` and `mix defk.examples.tables` fold in as regions and are deleted; no aliases (their only callers are docs/agents/generated-docs.md and the CI alias).
- `docs/compile-errors.md` is a whole generated file; the lists in `docs/scope.md` and the two usage-rules files get marker regions as HTML comments (`<!-- defk:generated ... -->`), which render as nothing in the shipped package.
- The three doc tests are deleted; `mix ci` runs `defk.docs --check`.
- Update docs/agents/generated-docs.md, AGENTS.md's "Generated docs" paragraph, the compiler map's errors and messages bullets.

Deletion test: deleting the paste instructions concentrates regeneration in one place. Gate: `mix ci` (with the new check); PR per AGENTS.md; CHANGELOG only if a shipped file's text changes.
title: mix defk.docs [--check]: every generated doc region behind one task
